subject.title: Support isolated native subagent workspaces with workspace-only skills

question: Should `sessions_spawn` expose a native-only, per-run child workspace mode for dynamic skill bundles while retaining the existing server-owned workspace boundary and documenting that it is discovery isolation rather than host authorization?
rationale: Current main deliberately keeps spawned workspace overrides internal after a gateway-boundary hardening change, while the requested public API would create a new persistent workspace and skill-discovery contract.

options.title: Approve a narrow discovery-only mode
options.body: Sponsor a native-only validated descendant-workspace API with server-owned persisted lineage, explicit workspace-only skill discovery, and unchanged ACP behavior.

options.title: Use static agent profiles instead
options.body: Keep the current target-agent workspace model and direct users to per-agent `skills` allowlists plus sandbox/tool restrictions for fixed worker profiles.

options.title: Defer dynamic isolation
options.body: Leave the current public API unchanged until a broader agent-isolation product model is defined.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow discovery-only mode
recommendation.body: Sponsor a native-only validated descendant-workspace API with server-owned persisted lineage, explicit workspace-only skill discovery, and unchanged ACP behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior workspace-lineage hardening establishes the relevant security boundary for deciding whether and how a public override may exist.
